name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.3-beta+2

- Windows: fix the in-app update closing the app without updating
- Long-press an anime episode to set your progress
  - Holding an episode on an anime page now opens a small menu: mark watched up to that episode, set progress back, or choose a source (what holding did before). Needs AniList, MAL or Simkl signed in; without one it goes straight to the source picker as before.
  - TV report: also says which subtitle and audio the phone asked the TV for, to track down videos whose subtitles don't show.
